She had spinal surgery that went wrong and she is in severe agony, to be told by Dr Coull that it could all be in her head - he proceeded to ask her if she was ever abused as a child (!??) and referred her to a psychiatrist as opposed to actually addressing the cause of her pain. She is still suffering greatly whilst waiting for specialist treatment and whilst I acknowledge that the referral side is out of their hands, to suggest that a woman with disc collapse and scoliosis following massive spinal surgery doesn't have pain because of something physical is ridiculous. Anyone I have mentioned this to has been equally horrified. They are fine if you aren't expecting chronic pain to be taken seriously.

EDIT: Another star lost due to the ATROCIOUS way Dr Coull has treated my mother just today. She has serious spinal scoliosis after an operation gone wrong and she is in agony, YET AGAIN Dr Coull has told her the pain is ALL IN HER HEAD??? He said it was because of her childhood she was in pain? She has never been abused and does not have any mental health issues but who needs facts when you are Dr Coull? Would he say the same if someone's leg was hanging off? I am absolutely appalled that a doctor does not seem to believe in pain caused by physical issues. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

Other corkers from Dr Coull:

'Youre 67, all woman of that age experience SOME pain'
'Gabapentin isn't pain relief' (apparently neuropathic pain doesn't exist in his book..? As someone who is medically trained myself this is nonsense)

Gas lighter of the highest degree and has recently claimed that he was only looking out for patient safety when he decided to essentially accuse my mum of making up her pain so he could take her off her medication that she is in agony without. Certainly he doesn't seem to believe in pain unless you have a limb hanging off. Apparently it is all in our heads. The man should not be practicing as a doctor.

UPDATE: To provide further context to the above some competent medical professionals have agreed that in fact my mum does need another spinal operation due to how severe her pain is and, funny enough, they believed that she was in physical pain the first time she brought it up. It is wonderful what a medical professional can do when they know what they are doing.",null,[0,238]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNkdDlQaHlBRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x4b2f100b01966bf2!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgICdt9PhyAE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNkdDlQaHlBRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNkdDlQaHlBRRIlChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNkdDlQaEtBEgswY0RwNjZYUXhSMhouChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNkdDlQaHFBRRITQ2d3SW1wNk9zZ1lRNE43bXlnRSISCQAAAAAAAAAAEfJrlgELEC9LKhNDZ3dJbS0yOXNnWVFnT1BMMEFN&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwii3fD_8reTAxULKGMBHRqOJyYQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwii3fD_8reTAxULKGMBHRqOJyYQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURVZMVFRoZlgxOWZSV2hCVFdOM2MweERPVFZNVm10WE1VVkRORUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEl6YTBOaFRtaEpha2RaV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNzNU5qMjJnRRAB",["0x0:0x4b2f100b01966bf2",null,1579714729260738,1579714729260738,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/100936675057791913156/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Andrew King","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUQSQ1R-l_2hd5MSFOrXe3lmUg1ERCs4ZmX7li30V_PW2Pkf6dyFA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/100936675057791913156?hl=en"],"100936675057791913156",null,4,7,null,[0,3,1],0,["4 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwii3fD_8reTAxULKGMBHRqOJyYQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"6 years ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["My partner and I love this practice.
